description: This file defines the CoinDetailFragment class, which is a Fragment responsible for displaying detailed information about a cryptocurrency, including price charts and other relevant data.

classes.name: CoinDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays detailed information about a specific cryptocurrency, including its price and historical trends.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment and initializes the binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the toolbar, chart, and observes UI and watchlist state.

methods.name: setupTimeframeChips
methods.description: Sets up the timeframe chips to load different data sets.

methods.name: observeUiState
methods.description: Observes the UI state from the view model and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates UI elements with data from the success state.

methods.name: updateChart
methods.description: Updates the displayed chart with the selected cryptocurrency data.

methods.name: observeWatchlistState
methods.description: Observes the watchlist state and updates the button text accordingly.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears the binding when the view is destroyed.
